sam: Heads up — after running the quantized bring-up for redwood-quant-4b-alpha on promptset_B we see a surprising drop on short numeric QA exact-match vs float32 baseline. Initial hunch: synthetic augmentation introduced label noise. Samples attached: https://storage.internal/curation/1893001234/samples.json :thinking:

maya: @lina @owen can you paste a couple failing examples here?

sam: one quick example:
```
Q: "What is 12+7?"
Gold: "19"
Model(quant4b): "2"
```
looks like numbers got mangled during paraphrase augmentation.

lina: Yep — I inspected a handful. The paraphraser sometimes changed digits (OCR-like substitutions) and the labeler pipeline didn't normalize numerics before dedupe. We end up with duplicate prompts that have inconsistent labels. Suggest: normalize numbers (digits-only canonicalization) + dedupe on normalized fingerprint.

owen: agree. I'll run a dedupe fingerprint pass keyed on normalized numeric tokens. Proposed command: `python tools/dedupe.py --key normalized_number_tokens --input promptset_B.json --out promptset_B_dedup.json` ETA ~2h.

felix: FYI labeling capacity is tight this week. If we need relabels, we should prioritize a targeted golden relabel (top 500 failing examples) instead of whole-set relabel. Also we should add a toggle to the augmentation pipeline so we can disable synthetic paraphrases for sensitive numeric tasks.

maya: @qa-bot quick-eval run posted: EM_drop: 7.4%, BLEU_delta: -2.1. job: qa-job-1893001234. failures ~512/7000 :eyes:

qa-bot: automated: quick-eval finished. failures=512; sample_fail_ids=[s_1023,s_2044,s_3099,s_4122,s_5590,s_6001,s_6222,s_7000]

sam: Plan of action:
1) @owen run dedupe + numeric normalization on promptset_B (blocking).
2) shrink golden to top-500 failing examples and queue focused relabel batch.
3) disable synthetic augmentation flag for subsequent evals and add augmentation metric in CI.
4) rerun quant eval after relabel and compare with baseline.
@felix can you confirm labeler availability? @lina can you review normalization rules?

lina: on it — I'll post normalization rules in this thread and add unit tests for numeric canonicalization. Also recommend adding a numeric-token check to the eval hook so we get an early signal in future model bring-ups.

felix: :thumbsup: I can free up 2 labelers starting tomorrow 13:00 PT. If we prioritize the top-500 batch we should close relabel within ~48h.

owen: starting dedupe job now. will post progress. (`dedupe:start -> 0%` 😅)

sam: thanks everyone. upload dedup output and relabel manifests to /mnt/curation/1893001234/ and tag this thread when done. I'll open a small PR to add the aug toggle and CI metric now.

maya: also logging this as a post-check in the quant experiments spreadsheet so we can correlate quantization configs -> failure modes.

sam: perfect. ping here when dedupe finishes or if any blocker shows up.
